notes.title: An apology
notes.notes:
From the global outbreak of the 2019-nCoV till now in mid-June this year, the progress of the update of the Pandamonia project's 'Zodiac Signs' DLC is almost at a standstill. Because there has been another very important working stuff to deal with recently, and many variables have occurred in personal family business. Therefore here is a brief explanation of the current situation. At the same time, I hope that all my friends and comrades who have supported me along the way can give me a certain understanding. Right here I send my apology solemnly to everyone.
3 days ago on my birthday, I made a very important decision. From September onwards, I will revise and optimize the original rendering style of this game, and may also launch a multiplayer online mode. This has been planned to be implemented since the beginning of last year, but due to insufficient capital flow and personal energy is quite limited, so this plan has been delayed.
But in the end, I would like to appreciate all the friends who have purchased my game again. Even in the current most difficult period, there are still many players who have put forward constructive opinions and support and encouragement. So one thing is pretty assured that I will be back with a brand new look with this game!

notes.title: The early-access state of Pandamonia has been cancelled!
notes.notes:
Good morning my dear friends!

The early-access state of Pandamonia has been cancelled. And I might have something to tell you below:

Since my personal physical condition is getting worse these months, I have to cancel the early-access state of this game earlier than I can expected. I'm very sorry to do so but I have no choice. You know it is really difficult for me to develop this game from the beginning without any technical support and with a very low income. My life sucks just like this whole damn game. However, this doesn't mean I won't develop and update this project in the future. CO-OP mode will be no doubt considered and I'm still working hard on it, so be aware of this my friends.

Due to some local policies in my home country, my next new game project might be no longer using Chinese translations and it won't be shown in the local shop lists. 

In the end, many thanks for all of ya these months, for giving me mental supports and some helpful technical advice. I'm convinced that I'll do pretty better and better in the future.

Peace out, my friends, hope you all living a very good life!

Sincerely,
Hoffman Chang

notes.title: 有时候也是感觉蛮无语的
notes.notes:
童鞋们大家好，

今天拿到了第一份营销收入，看到最后的账单我整个人都感觉不太好了。其实说句实话，这段时间以来我一直都有在反思，究竟是自己的目标不正确，还是说细节上处理得还不够到位，不太符合大众的口味。。。。。。

可能也是本身自己就不适合混独立游戏这块领域吧，没有什么天赋。不过也不多想了，从今天开始，个人决定，重新调整潘德莫尼亚的游戏价格，从原来的6rmb调整到11rmb，就这样定了吧。对此我也是深感抱歉，但也是没办法。生活已经如此艰难，有些事情也没必要太纠结了。在此之前很多同行就已经劝过我这个定价确实不合理了，只是我没听进去。现在的1月份2019年的收入数据确实非常难看，随着开发进度的推进，尤其是后期的剩下几关大反攻剧情和生存模式地图，成本多多少少都会有些偏高。所以也是真心希望朋友们能给予些理解。

最后也没啥想说的了，祝大家生活愉快。我自己也不会灰心，会继续做得更好，重新端正自身的态度，继续砥砺前行。

开发者霍夫曼张撰于
2019年2月27日

Also I found out something wrong - the price of Pandamonia is quite unreasonable and many of my colleagues suggest me to reprice the game. So I've made my own decision - 0.99$ to 1.99$. I feel very sorry for this but life's just becoming so tough and I have no choice. I sincerely hope ya all can understand. 

Maybe I'm just not good enough to be a game developer, or maybe I still have much more to learn. Well...whatever

Yours,
Hoffman Chang

notes.title: New Updates today (Date: 2019-01-11)
notes.notes:
Hi there, you can now add your own customized battle music into the game folder now. Here are the steps below:

1.Right click on Pandamonia in the game library, choose Properties.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34145235/c5e1f8f38a23d4a9f56c426f9cd354ad52d3de28.png[/img]
2.LOCAL FILES ----> BROWSE LOCAL FILES...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34145235/c2f32af5ff26cdbbb3bb8d5082e343583e61b3b0.png[/img]
3.In the game root folder, choose PC_Data
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34145235/95cf7a27582c63fd99885f4becae7d4e97f326dd.png[/img]
4.Choose Music folder
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34145235/c149b1463cdfe927c35f4d7fb1f2a310cdee9129.png[/img]
5.Inside the Music folder, for example, if you wanna replace the battle music of Day 3, then copy and paste an mp3 format file into this folder, rename it "day3fight.mp3". Then launch your game, the BGM should have been replaced.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34145235/391625bf7823eee02ea20b22a258b9703e511277.png[/img]

FILENAME FORMAT : dayxfight.mp3 (x means day level in game)

Thank you all the same...

Yours,
Hoffman Chang
